events.quote: Will anybody object to move this proposal to the review status. Awesome.
events.note: No objections were raised on the call. Pooja stated this was for moving EIP-7773 Glamsterdam Meta EIP to Review status (not a mainnet inclusion stage). However 'included' is not the right mapping here — the spoken decision was to move to 'Review' status in the EIP process. The closest schema stage is not a perfect match; recording as low-confidence. The transcript does not contain a formal SFI vote for devnet-7 EIPs; only a proposal to ratify at the next ACDE/ACDC call on Thursday was discussed.

events.quote: I think we can try to schedule it for next week, but there have been quite a few people on holiday or haven't been here yet because of other reasons, so… I think it might make sense not to rush DevNet 8. I think next week or the week after would both be fine.
